fields.name: Ćevabdžinica Nune
fields.descriptionBs: Tradicionalna sarajevska ćevabdžinica u Ferhadiji, poznata po ćevapima, sudžukicama i drugim jelima sa roštilja.
fields.descriptionEn: A traditional Sarajevo ćevapi restaurant on Ferhadija Street, serving ćevapi, grilled sausages and other barbecue specialties.

fields.name: Dveri
fields.descriptionBs: Mali restoran u srcu Baščaršije sa ponudom bosanske i evropske kuhinje u tradicionalnom ambijentu.
fields.descriptionEn: A small restaurant in the heart of Baščaršija offering Bosnian and European dishes in a traditional setting.

fields.name: Restaurant REUFF
fields.descriptionBs: Restoran sa širokom ponudom bosanske, italijanske i internacionalne kuhinje, uključujući pizze iz krušne peći.
fields.descriptionEn: A restaurant offering Bosnian, Italian and international cuisine, including wood-fired pizza.

fields.name: burgrs Sarajevo
fields.descriptionBs: Specijalizovani burger restoran sa smash burgerima od goveđeg mesa, pomfritom i različitim umacima.
fields.descriptionEn: A burger restaurant specializing in beef smash burgers, fries and a selection of house sauces.

fields.name: Klopa
fields.descriptionBs: Restoran u centru Sarajeva sa kombinacijom bosanske i internacionalne kuhinje te mesnih, ribljih i vegetarijanskih jela.
fields.descriptionEn: A central Sarajevo restaurant combining Bosnian and international cuisine with meat, seafood and vegetarian dishes.

fields.name: Restoran Careva Ćuprija
fields.descriptionBs: Restoran na Baščaršiji sa tradicionalnim bosanskim, kontinentalnim i mediteranskim specijalitetima.
fields.descriptionEn: A Baščaršija restaurant serving traditional Bosnian, continental and Mediterranean specialties.

fields.name: Ćevabdžinica Petica Ferhatović
fields.descriptionBs: Tradicionalna ćevabdžinica porodice Ferhatović na Baščaršiji sa ćevapima, pljeskavicama i sudžukicama.
fields.descriptionEn: A traditional Ferhatović family ćevapi restaurant in Baščaršija serving ćevapi, pljeskavica and grilled sausages.

fields.name: Ćevabdžinica Željo
fields.descriptionBs: Jedna od poznatih sarajevskih ćevabdžinica na Baščaršiji, specijalizovana za ćevape u somunu.
fields.descriptionEn: A well-known Sarajevo ćevapi restaurant in Baščaršija specializing in ćevapi served in traditional flatbread.

fields.name: Buregdžinica Bosna
fields.descriptionBs: Tradicionalna buregdžinica u Bravadžiluku sa burekom i drugim vrstama svježe pripremljenih bosanskih pita.
fields.descriptionEn: A traditional burek shop on Bravadžiluk Street serving burek and other freshly prepared Bosnian pies.

fields.name: Cakum-Pakum
fields.descriptionBs: Manji restoran u centru Sarajeva sa italijanskim i mediteranskim jelima, uključujući tjestenine i mesna jela.
fields.descriptionEn: A small central Sarajevo restaurant serving Italian and Mediterranean dishes including pasta and meat dishes.

fields.name: The Four Rooms of Mrs. Safija
fields.descriptionBs: Restoran u historijskoj kući na Čekaluši koji kombinuje internacionalnu, francusku i fusion gastronomiju sa vinskim i lounge prostorom.
fields.descriptionEn: A restaurant in a historic Čekaluša house combining international, French and fusion cuisine with wine and lounge areas.

fields.name: PekSar
fields.descriptionBs: Restoran i coffee shop u centru Sarajeva koji spaja pekarske proizvode sa modernom internacionalnom i evropskom gastronomijom.
fields.descriptionEn: A central Sarajevo restaurant and coffee shop combining bakery products with modern international and European cuisine.

fields.name: Falafel Restaurant
fields.descriptionBs: Vegetarijanski restoran na Baščaršiji fokusiran na falafel, hummus i druga mediteranska i bliskoistočna jela.
fields.descriptionEn: A vegetarian restaurant in Baščaršija focused on falafel, hummus and other Mediterranean and Middle Eastern dishes.

fields.name: Buregdžinica Sač
fields.descriptionBs: Buregdžinica na Baščaršiji specijalizovana za tradicionalne bosanske pite pripremljene i pečene pod sačem.
fields.descriptionEn: A Baščaršija burek shop specializing in traditional Bosnian pies prepared and baked under a sač.

fields.name: Avlija Sarajevo
fields.descriptionBs: Restoran prepoznatljiv po ambijentu tradicionalne bosanske avlije i ponudi domaćih i internacionalnih jela.
fields.descriptionEn: A restaurant characterized by a traditional Bosnian courtyard atmosphere and a selection of local and international dishes.

fields.name: Kibe Mahala
fields.descriptionBs: Tradicionalni bosanski restoran na padinama iznad Sarajeva, poznat po nacionalnim jelima, janjetini sa ražnja i panoramskom pogledu.
fields.descriptionEn: A traditional Bosnian restaurant on the hills above Sarajevo, serving national dishes and spit-roasted lamb with panoramic city views.

fields.name: Food Station
fields.descriptionBs: Fast-food restoran na Ilidži sa burgerima, pizzama, jelima sa roštilja i drugim brzim obrocima.
fields.descriptionEn: A fast-food restaurant in Ilidža serving burgers, pizza, grilled dishes and other quick meals.

fields.name: Mala Kuhinja
fields.descriptionBs: Intimni sarajevski restoran sa kreativnim pristupom internacionalnoj i fusion kuhinji.
fields.descriptionEn: An intimate Sarajevo restaurant with a creative approach to international and fusion cuisine.

fields.name: Restoran Libertas
fields.descriptionBs: Mediteranski restoran u centru Sarajeva specijalizovan za svježu ribu, plodove mora, dalmatinska jela i vina.
fields.descriptionEn: A Mediterranean restaurant in central Sarajevo specializing in fresh fish, seafood, Dalmatian dishes and wine.

fields.name: Sedef
fields.descriptionBs: Restoran u Ferhadiji sa bosanskim specijalitetima kao što su bosanski lonac, dolme, sitni ćevap i kuhana jela.
fields.descriptionEn: A Ferhadija restaurant serving Bosnian specialties such as Bosnian pot, dolma, sitni ćevap and traditional cooked dishes.

fields.name: Konoba Luka Sarajevo
fields.descriptionBs: Mediteranski restoran uz Miljacku specijalizovan za svježu ribu, škampe, hobotnicu i druge morske plodove.
fields.descriptionEn: A Mediterranean restaurant by the Miljacka specializing in fresh fish, prawns, octopus and other seafood.

fields.name: Casa El Gitano
fields.descriptionBs: Porodični restoran na Paromlinskoj sa ponudom italijanske, španske i domaće kuhinje te jelima sa roštilja.
fields.descriptionEn: A family restaurant on Paromlinska Street offering Italian, Spanish and local cuisine alongside grilled dishes.

fields.name: Da Zero Pizza
fields.descriptionBs: Pizzeria specijalizovana za napolitanski stil pizze sa klasičnim i modernim kombinacijama sastojaka.
fields.descriptionEn: A pizzeria specializing in Neapolitan-style pizza with both classic and modern topping combinations.

fields.name: Frankie's street food Sarajevo
fields.descriptionBs: Street-food restoran u centru Sarajeva sa burgerima, tacosima i drugim savremenim jelima brze hrane.
fields.descriptionEn: A central Sarajevo street-food restaurant serving burgers, tacos and other contemporary fast-food dishes.

fields.name: Restoran Tavola
fields.descriptionBs: Italijanski i mediteranski restoran u centru Sarajeva poznat po domaćoj tjestenini, raviolima, njokama, steakovima i morskim plodovima.
fields.descriptionEn: An Italian and Mediterranean restaurant in central Sarajevo serving homemade pasta, ravioli, gnocchi, steaks and seafood.

fields.name: Tapas Bar & Restaurant
fields.descriptionBs: Restoran u centru Sarajeva sa mediteranskim, italijanskim i španskim utjecajima te jelima pripremljenim u krušnoj peći.
fields.descriptionEn: A central Sarajevo restaurant with Mediterranean, Italian and Spanish influences and dishes prepared in a wood-fired oven.

fields.name: Fijaker Ilidža
fields.descriptionBs: Restoran na Ilidži sa tradicionalnim bosanskim jelima, mesnim specijalitetima i jelima sa roštilja.
fields.descriptionEn: An Ilidža restaurant serving traditional Bosnian dishes, meat specialties and grilled food.

fields.name: Gazi-Han
fields.descriptionBs: Restoran na području Novog Grada sa ponudom tradicionalnih i internacionalnih jela za doručak i ručak.
fields.descriptionEn: A restaurant in the Novi Grad area serving traditional and international dishes for breakfast and lunch.

fields.name: Only One Chinese Restaurant
fields.descriptionBs: Kineski restoran na Koševu sa jelima tradicionalne kineske kuhinje, wok specijalitetima i vegetarijanskim opcijama.
fields.descriptionEn: A Chinese restaurant in the Koševo area serving traditional Chinese cuisine, wok dishes and vegetarian options.

fields.name: Kilim Ilidža
fields.descriptionBs: Kafe-restoran na Ilidži sa ponudom doručka, ručka, večere, deserata i različitih à la carte jela.
fields.descriptionEn: A café-restaurant in Ilidža serving breakfast, lunch, dinner, desserts and a varied à la carte menu.
